ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a large triangle ADE, A is on the left side, D is at the upper right, and E is at the lower right. Point C is located on side AD, point B is located on side AE, and line segment CB connects C and B. CB and the right side DE both have the same arrow markings, indicating CB ∥ DE. Reasoning: Because CB ∥ DE, according to the triangle proportionality theorem, sides AD and AE are divided proportionally in correspondence, so AC/CD = AB/BE. It is known that AC = x - 3, CD = x + 5, AB = 16, BE = 20; substituting gives (x - 3)/(x + 5) = 16/20. Simplifying gives (x - 3)/(x + 5) = 4/5, cross-multiplying: 5(x - 3) = 4(x + 5), that is, 5x - 15 = 4x + 20, so x = 35. Thus AC = x - 3 = 35 - 3 = 32.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the smaller triangle ABC inside the larger triangle ADE, with CB parallel to DE. Therefore triangles ABC and ADE are similar. From the text, AC = x - 3, CD = x + 5, AB = 16, and BE = 20. Build whole-side lengths: AD = AC + CD = (x - 3) + (x + 5) = 2x + 2, and AE = AB + BE = 16 + 20 = 36. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一个大三角形 ADE，A 在左侧，D 在右上方，E 在右下方；点 C 位于边 AD 上，点 B 位于边 AE 上，线段 CB 连接 C 和 B。图中 CB 与右侧的 DE 都近似竖直，并且都有相同方向的箭头标记，表示 CB ∥ DE。因此，三角形 ABC 是大三角形 ADE 内部的一个小三角形，且 △ABC ∼ △ADE。

推理：由题意 AC = x - 3，CD = x + 5，所以整条边 AD = AC + CD = (x - 3) + (x + 5) = 2x + 2。又因为 AB = 16，BE = 20，所以整条边 AE = AB + BE = 16 + 20 = 36。由 △ABC ∼ △ADE，对应边成比例：AC/AD = AB/AE。代入得 (x - 3)/(2x + 2) = 16/36。化简 16/36 = 4/9，所以 9(x - 3) = 4(2x + 2)。展开：9x - 27 = 8x + 8，解得 x = 35。因此 AC = x - 3 = 35 - 3 = 32。
